description: A number of an agent run summed over one node's whole subtree (the node itself included) — what a parent row of TmAgentRunTree shows. Every value keeps the not-reported contract: a value no node of the subtree reports is null, never zero, so "reports no cost" and "cost nothing" stay distinguishable.
usageExample:
var rollup = AgentRunRollup.For("root", nodes, now);
Console.WriteLine($"{rollup.NodeCount} nodes, {rollup.DescendantCount} sub-agents, cost {rollup.CostMicroUnits}, tokens {rollup.Tokens}, time {rollup.Duration}");
